rules: CTRL_RUNNING.main takes the party leader as NPC_PIRATE_X (capturepc(-1), :160), shows "Let the tier [value] race begin! (Press [icon] and [icon] alternately to run.)" with the tier in [value] and a button icon at each [icon] (:297-302) and starts the four running_main functions (:305). The player's runner keeps its default run speed (NPC_PIRATE_X.running_main :8528); each new press of pad bit 0x2000 or 0x4000 (Circle or Cross, padt) gives it 5 x the frame step (call 0x5D2) ticks of running (:8537-8539, :8556-8558, :8575, :8728) and with no ticks left it stops (:8733); a second press of the same button in a row turns its heading by 0.12 x call 0x5D3, bit 0x2000 one way and bit 0x4000 the other, while the turn is not past 0.36 x call 0x5D3, and alternating the two leaves the heading alone (:8540-8554, :8559-8573); the script steers the course itself (:8586-8605). The rivals run at multiples of the player's runner's default run speed (:7438, :7871, :8293), with cut = 0.0012 x (100 - tier) (CTRL_RUNNING.main :189). Rikken (actor 9), tested every tick: x (1.02 - cut) while the player's runner is farther than 1.2 + 0.005 x tier from him or his x is below 80, else x (1.2 - cut) (:188, NPC_PIRATE_0.running_main :7449-7456); his heading offset rises 0.0012 a tick to 0.05 past x 80 and falls 0.0008 a tick to -0.05 while his z is above 170 (:7540-7554). Elza (actor 10): x (1.01 - cut), set once (NPC_PIRATE_1.running_main :7872); past x 80 her heading offset rises 0.009 a tick to 0.09 while the player's runner is within 1.2 + 0.005 x (100 - tier) of her and falls 0.009 a tick to -0.09 otherwise (:187, :7969-7983). Raz (actor 11): x 1 (NPC_PIRATE_2.running_main :8294), heading offset 0.1 x sin of a phase that starts at 0.01 x rand_29(314) and grows 0.015 a tick (:8272, :8392-8393); between x 80 and x 117 he stumbles (motion 0x10000005, sounds 109 and 110, waits of 5, 25 and 15 ticks) whenever the player's runner is within 1.2 + 0.005 x (100 - tier) of him or his tick counter is 0, which it is at the start; each stumble sets his speed to x 1.26 and the counter to (tier + 16) x 8, or to 10000 once a runner has finished (:8273, :8358-8385). The same stumble branch in the other three runners is switched off by a constant 0 (:7514, :7940, :8645). A runner finishes when, on the non-negative side of the line (97.7, 173.7)-(104.4, 176.2) and with z at most 139, its x reaches 120.3; it then adds 1 to the finish count file_var_s2_6 (:7459-7489, :7885-7915, :8307-8337, :8579-8609), and the player's place is that count when the player's runner finishes (:8625)
limits: the tier, global byte 0x73C, 1 to 100: a race that finds it 0 sets it to 1 (CTRL_RUNNING.main :183-186) and a first place raises it by 1 only while it is below 100 (:738-741 and the ten sibling branches to :4940-4943), so it stays at 100; from tier 1 to tier 100 Rikken's two factors go from 0.9012 and 1.0812 to 1.02 and 1.2, Elza's from 0.8912 to 1.01, and Raz's stumble counter from 136 to 928 ticks; no time limit: the result is read once all four runners have finished (file_var_s2_6 at 4, :306-309)
reward: first place: Rikken's line, then the tier's package, 0x908F + tier - 1 (0x908F at tier 1 to 0x90F2 at tier 100; additemmes, :339-735 and the same 100 cases in each tier branch), then the tier rises by 1, or at tier 100 byte 0x73D is set to 1 (:4511-4518). The line is "Nice, very nice! First place! Here's your prize!" (:4533), except one line each at tiers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80 and 90 (:331, :750, :1169, :1588, :2007, :2426, :2845, :3264, :3683; tier 10: "Impressive! First place! There's more to you than I thought!") and "Unbelievable! I daresay you're the fastest man in Ivalice!" at tier 100 (:4104). At tier 100 the package 0x90F2 is given only while byte 0x73D is 0 (:4100, :4508); once it is 1 a tier-100 first place gets the line alone (:4520-4528). The packages run from a Potion (0x908F) to 10000 gil, two Elixirs and an Unpurified Ether (0x90F2) (scene-rewards.tsv). After any place, while quest scenario flag 159 is 10, HUNTxx.talkClient follows and the held place is cleared (:4976-4991, :5044-5047)
fail: second place: "Nice running... Second place!" (CTRL_RUNNING.main :4951-4958); third place: "Third place. Better luck next time!" (:4959-4966); any other place: "You've got a ways to go before you can hope to best us." (:4967-4974). No package is given and the tier stays; the race can be run again at once
gauge: no gauge: the listing has no gauge call; the tier is shown as the [value] of the opening message (setmesmacro(1, 0, 0, tier) and setmesmacro(0, 0, 0, tier), :297-298)
